causal_support.interpretation: Retarded initial conditions make the response causal, while the adjoint multiplier generated by an ordinary endpoint variation has advanced support. The CTP contour can select the former only by treating the multipliers as response variables or physical fields with fixed state.

localized_kinetic_matrix.interpretation: Each A-U or B-Q constraint block has eigenvalues plus/minus |mixing|. Changing its overall sign only exchanges eigenvectors and cannot make the localization positive definite.

scope: This rejects the exact constraint-localized v6D action. It does not prove that every UV-complete causal nonlocal theory or every healthy local gravitational carrier is impossible.
